{#- Where the page came from, and when it last changed. A page whose content is included or generated from elsewhere names that file as its source, and does not report a date: the date git holds is the date of the stub, not of what the reader is looking at. -#} {%- set source = page.meta.source if page and page.meta and page.meta.source else ("docs/src/" + page.file.src_uri if page and page.file else none) -%} {%- if source -%}

{%- endif -%}
